CustomField.formula: IF( OR( NOT(ISBLANK(Gift_Aid_Cancellation_Date__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Gift_Aid_Cancellation_Reason__c))) ), "Cancelled", IF( NumberOfActiveGiftAidClaimPeriods__c > 0, "Active", IF( NumberOfEndedGiftAidClaimPeriods__c > 0, "Former", "Not Declared" ) ) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Active: No end date in Gift Aid Coverage Period, Former: one or multiple ended Gift Aid Coverage Periods Cancelled: Either Gift Aid Cancellation Date or Gift Aid Cancellation Reason is not empty else Not Declared if none of the conditions are satisfied
CustomField.label: Gift Aid Status
